admission.justification: Refusing newly restated header labels prevents a prose dependency or branch/master label from contradicting the typed field on which projection and coordination rely without destroying historical notes.

applicability: New task_doc header notes whose labels restate master, parent sprint, dependency, execution nature or integration branch fields.
conditions: The refusal names the correct typed field.
Existing notes remain and may be edited or removed; an additional reserved-label note is new.
exclusions: Automatic rewriting of historical header notes.
statement: New header notes that restate master, parent sprint, dependency, execution nature or integration branch fields are refused with the proper field, while existing notes remain.
